name: Alfarràs (Spain)
description: Blue field with a yellow bend from the upper hoist to the lower fly over a white bend sinister, charged at the centre with a green box branch.
history: The official flag of Alfarràs is oblong, of proportions two high by three long, blue, with a yellow bend of width 1/9 of the height of the flag placed over a white bend sinister of the same width, and at the centre, on the yellow bend, a stylised green box branch of length 1/5 of the flag.

features.role: white bend sinister beneath a yellow bend, forming a saltire
bend from the upper hoist to the lower fly
